Name: Smaller Junimo Hut
Author: ninjor1
Description:
[size=5][b]Smaller Junimo Hut[/b][/size]
Makes the Junimo Hut 2×2 tiles instead of 3×2, so it fits into tighter farm layouts.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]2×2 footprint:[/b] new huts take up 2×2 tiles, both when placing them and once they're built. Huts you've already built shrink too when you load your save, keeping their top-left corner, so the tiles on their right become free.[/*]
[*][b]Shrunk to fit:[/b] the base game's hut sprite is 3 tiles wide, so it's drawn at two-thirds size to fit, along with its coin bag, lit window and raisin decoration. That's also how it looks in the Wizard's building menu.[/*]
[*][b]Retextures made for 2×2:[/b] if your hut retexture already draws the hut 2 tiles wide, it's drawn at full size. Only the coin bag moves, so it's on the hut.[/*]
[*][b]Junimos work as before:[/b] they still come and go from the hut's door tile and harvest the same area around it. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2221]Better Junimos[/url] works with it.[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer:[/b] every player needs the mod, since the hut's size must match.[/*]
[/list]
If you remove the mod, your huts go back to 3×2, so clear the tile to the right of each hut first.

This replaces Fernass354's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18457]Junimo Hut Size[/url], which no longer works on the current version of Stardew Valley.

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod into your game's [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Source code, bugs and suggestions[/b][/size]
The source code is on GitHub: [url=https://github.com/fnielson1/stardew-valley-mods]https://github.com/fnielson1/stardew-valley-mods[/url]
Please report bugs and suggestions as [url=https://github.com/fnielson1/stardew-valley-mods/issues]GitHub issues[/url].
